description:
Title: LAN Party

You are planning a LAN party for 10 friends, so the first thing you have to do is to send invitations to these 10 friends.
Next, you have to find out which games they want to play.
As soon as you have received a list of games, you can appoint a date when the LAN party is going to happen.
If 8 or more people agree on this date, you are good to continue.
Else, you have to appoint another date, until 8 people are free to join you.
While you find a date, you can find out if you have all the games your guests want to play.
If some are missing, download them.
Next, you should find out how much beer your friends will require.
If you do not have enough, buy what's missing.
After that, you can enjoy the LAN party.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Planner" name="LAN party planner" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitations" name="Invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="List of games they want to play" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PlanParty" name="Plan LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive list of games they want to play"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Find a date and check requested games"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateAgreement" name="Do 8 or more people agree on the date?" default="Flow_DateNotEnough"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Find out whether all requested games are available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesAvailable" name="Are all requested games available?" default="Flow_GamesMissing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Continue after checking requested games"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date agreed and requested games checked"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineBeer" name="Find out how much beer friends will require"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerEnough" name="Is there enough beer?" default="Flow_BeerNotEnough"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue after checking beer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SendInvitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_PlanParty" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendInvitations_ReceiveGameList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveGameList_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelSplit_AppointDate" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointDate_DateAgreement" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Gateway_DateAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateEnough" name="8 or more people agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriendsAgreeing >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNotEnough" name="Fewer than 8 people agree; appoint another date" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAgreement" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelSplit_CheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGames_GamesAvailable" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable" name="All requested games are available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allRequestedGamesAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing" name="Some requested games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DownloadGames_GamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_DetermineBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_DetermineBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineBeer_BeerEnough" sourceRef="Task_DetermineBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">beerAvailable >= beerRequired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerNotEnough" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_EnjoyParty" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnjoyParty_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
